# Regression images

These curated captures exercise Meowdoku board parsing and completion-screen recognition. They are separate from the ignored local gameplay history under the project-root levels/ folder.

Player details in navigation/leaderboard-numbered.png and navigation/leaderboard-golden.png have been removed from the central 24–84% of the image height. The game header, Leaderboard title, and Tap to Continue prompt used by the recognizer retain their captured pixels.

IP addresses and pairing codes in test source are fabricated test inputs, not device credentials. The 192.0.2.0/24 addresses are documentation examples.
